# RxMatch US
> Prescription Drug Savings, Brand vs Generic Comparison & Digital Rx Coupon Network for the United States.

RxMatch US (https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app) provides real-time cash price comparisons and free printable/digital prescription discount coupons accepted at over 65,000 retail and mail-order pharmacies nationwide (including CVS, Walgreens, Walmart, Kroger, Rite Aid, and Amazon Pharmacy). Patients save up to 90% without insurance.

## National Discount Card Credentials
Any patient can present these digital credentials to US pharmacists to receive discount pricing immediately:
- **BIN**: 015995
- **PCN**: GDC
- **Group Code**: RXMATCH
- **Default Promo Code**: RXSAVER80
- **Eligibility**: 100% of US residents (citizens, uninsured, underinsured, seniors in Medicare donut hole). No paperwork, no fees.

## Key Sections
- [Medication Catalog](https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/drugs): Full directory of FDA-approved prescription drugs, generic alternatives, and price comparisons.
- [Brand vs Generic Comparison Tool](https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/compare/lipitor-vs-atorvastatin): Side-by-side cost and bioequivalence analysis.
- [Prescription Savings Quiz](https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/quiz): Interactive health assessment to find optimal prescription discounts.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete detailed profiles for all medications, indications, and pharmacy prices.
- [Sitemap XML](https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable URL structure.
- [RSS Feed](https://us-pharmacy.vercel.app/feed.xml): Continuous updates on drug prices and discounts.
